sections.title: Dr. Alice Hale, *DMD*
body: Dr. Hale began working in dentistry in 1987 in an oral surgeon’s office, earned her degree in dental hygiene from the Medical College of Georgia in 1996, and worked as a registered dental hygienist for seven years.

She graduated from the Medical College of Georgia’s School of Dentistry in 2007, practiced as an associate dentist in North Augusta for six years, and bought her own practice in 2013. She is inspired by a purpose to prevent disease and heal people, understanding how the health of your mouth is tied to your overall health.

This was a pleasurable experience. The hygienist that cleaned my teeth did a very thorough job and was quite pleasant. They provided me with good service and explained to me my overall dental health.
